```plato

    // A columns x rows grid whose cell (c, r) is f(c, r).
    MakeArray2D(columns: Integer, rows: Integer, f: Function2<Integer, Integer, $T>): Array2D<$T>
    {
        var elements = MapRange(columns * rows, i => f(i % columns, i / columns));
        return (elements, columns, rows);
    }
```
